% \pdftexjaSetCharSpacing contract: preamble-only, HEX-validated,
% group-local, and asymmetric (pre = Latin->JA, post = JA->Latin).
% The widths are reported as CSP:<mode>:AJA and CSP:<mode>:JAA so the
% runner can compare them without a PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[jfm=pdftexja-jfm-ujis.def]{pdftexja}
\pdftexjaSetCharSpacing{6F22}{none}
\begin{document}
\setbox0\hbox{A漢}\typeout{CSP:none:AJA=\the\wd0}
\setbox0\hbox{漢A}\typeout{CSP:none:JAA=\the\wd0}
\end{document}
